decisions.description: Get together to work through the possible types of search, then decide at the next meeting which options to include

actions.description: Build the search interface -- tick-boxes and drop-down menus -- once the search fields have been decided
Research what the query language can do, as input to choosing the search options
Give the others a tutorial on accessing the corpus and walk them through the existing code and set-up

open_questions.description: What the system should be able to search for -- never agreed, and it blocks building the interface

notes: The search-interface mock-up turns out to be a screenshot of Google with the drop-downs pasted in (seg-0012), which is a nice trap: it reads like a delivered feature and is explicitly 'completely cut and pasted... that does not exist'. Recording it as a decision or a completed action would be wrong. 'Next week sometime' (seg-0048) for the tutorial is another relative deadline that stays null.
